intent.zh: 确认以数据驱动提升效率与质量，客户反馈闭环到设计
intent.en: Ensure data-driven improvements in efficiency and quality with customer feedback closing back into design.

questions.id: perf-是否设定并跟踪研发-kpi-一期通过率-缺陷密度-按期率-返工率-rma-ppm

text.zh: 是否设定并跟踪研发 KPI（一期通过率/缺陷密度/按期率/返工率/RMA/ppm）？
text.en: Do we define and track R&D KPIs (first-pass yield, defect density, on-time rate, rework rate, RMA, ppm)?

zh.1: 无研发 KPI 或仅口头关注。
zh.2: 有 KPI 指标但数据收集不完整。
zh.3: KPI 定期统计并通报，用于项目评估。
zh.4: KPI 结合目标对比与根因分析，推动改进。
zh.5: KPI 数据实时可视化，与激励/改进机制闭环。

en.1: No R&D KPIs or only informal attention.
en.2: KPIs exist but data collection is incomplete.
en.3: KPIs are compiled and shared regularly for project review.
en.4: KPIs are compared against targets with root-cause analysis to drive improvements.
en.5: KPI data is visualized in real time and ties into incentive and improvement mechanisms.

focus: 研发 KPI 指标体系
ask: 关键 KPI 如何计算？
指标异常如何触发行动？
threshold: 核心 KPI 常态化监控并驱动改进

focus: Mechanisms that drive improvements via metrics
ask: How do metric exceptions trigger actions?
threshold: Core KPIs are monitored routinely and drive improvements

questions.id: perf-是否开展项目复盘-ll-lessons-learned-并沉淀为设计与工艺标准

text.zh: 是否开展项目复盘/LL（Lessons Learned）并沉淀为设计与工艺标准？
text.en: Do we run project retrospectives/Lessons Learned and feed them into design and process standards?

zh.1: 无项目复盘或经验沉淀机制。
zh.2: 零散复盘，输出未标准化。
zh.3: 定期开展复盘并形成 Lessons Learned 文档。
zh.4: 复盘结论转化为规范/检查表并跟踪落实。
zh.5: LL 库与项目流程结合，自动提醒复用并衡量成效。

en.1: No project retrospectives or knowledge retention mechanism.
en.2: Retrospectives are ad-hoc with non-standard outputs.
en.3: Retrospectives happen regularly with Lessons Learned documentation.
en.4: Retrospective outcomes become standards/checklists with tracked implementation.
en.5: Lessons Learned repository integrates with project flow, prompting reuse and measuring impact.

ask: 版本更新如何通知到项目？
回写标准后如何验证执行？
threshold: 关键设计规范受控且及时更新
复盘成果沉淀并在项目中复用

focus: Cadence and scope of project retrospectives
ask: How are standards archived and controlled?
How are version updates communicated to projects?
How is execution verified after standards are updated?
threshold: Critical design standards are controlled and updated promptly
Retrospective outcomes are captured and reused in projects
